title: The Blue and Pink Sparkle New Year's Eve Mocktail Bar
description: A blue and pink New Year's Eve mocktail bar from Amazon: blue coupe glasses, a pink cocktail shaker set, a hand-blown blue-rim pitcher, a gold Happy New Year sign, pink pearl rimming sugar and gold glitter stirrers.
intro: Last New Year's Eve I handed my sister a drink in a plastic cup and she looked at me like I'd let her down personally. Fair. So this year the kitchen island is a full mocktail bar. Blue coupes, a pink shaker, a big hand-blown pitcher of pink lemonade, and sparkly sugar on every rim. Nobody needs champagne to feel fancy at midnight. They just need a cute glass and a gold stirrer to wave around.

sections.heading: The glasses and the pour
paragraphs: The Ocean Blue coupes come as a set of 4, 7 oz each, and they make literally anything look like a cocktail. The Dos Sueños pitcher is hand-blown recycled glass with a cobalt rim and handle, 84 oz, so one batch of pink lemonade covers the whole party. Every one is a little different, which I love.

sections.heading: The mixing station
paragraphs: The pink KITESSENSU shaker set comes with a jigger and a twisted bar spoon, and it stands about 10 in tall. Shake up a sparkling cranberry or a pink lemonade spritz and act like you know what you're doing. I don't. It still works.

sections.heading: The sparkle
paragraphs: Pink Pearl rimming sugar in a 4 oz tin, a pack of 50 gold glitter stirrers, and a gold metal Happy New Year sign on a wood base (13.8 in wide). Rim the glasses, drop in a stirrer, done. The sign does the decorating for you.

sections.heading: Shop it
paragraphs: Every piece is linked below and on my New Year's Eve Mocktail Bar Idea List: https://www.amazon.com/shop/thedigitalincomeedit/list/2ECRTRBEWW02P. Every look I make lives on my Amazon storefront: https://www.amazon.com/shop/thedigitalincomeedit

paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The drinks, food, rooms, props and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
